findings.issue_category: missing key rotation and overly permissive default policy
findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which weakens cryptographic hygiene over time. Additionally, no explicit key policy is defined, meaning AWS applies the default KMS key policy that grants full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM, which can lead to overly broad access to this sensitive audit-trail encryption key if not tightly scoped in IAM.
